verdict.rationale: Ashby's analytics docs cite offer acceptance rate by team, average time in process, and breakdowns by source as out-of-the-box reports. They also describe customizable templates and a from-scratch report builder, with analytics built into the all-in-one platform. The Assistant can additionally give per-role pipeline updates. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of stage-to-stage conversion reporting, documented per-role time-to-hire metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy.
